brief:
Portugal's foreign minister said Monday that Israeli settlement expansion and economic pressure in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem were undermining prospects for a viable Palestinian state, according to Al-Monitor. The remarks reflected growing European criticism of Israeli policies in occupied Palestinian territories.

The statement came as settlement construction continues to expand across the West Bank, a core point of contention in Israeli-Palestinian peace negotiations.
dek: LISBON, Sept 14 (Reuters) - Portugal's foreign minister said on Monday that Israeli settlement expansion and economic pressure in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem were undermining prospects for a viable Palestinian state.
title: Portugal accuses Israel of undermining Palestinian statehood through settlements
